turnos.pregunta: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
consultas: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
turnos.respuesta:
Removal is the one part nobody can pin down from a description — strippable papers come off in clean lengths, while older or painted-over layers can fight back and reveal repair work underneath. That's why it usually takes someone seeing the wall to say anything useful about it.

We do removal as well as the hanging, so it'd be one team either way. Whenever you're ready for someone to take a look, I can pass your details on.
